newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal copper workers reject deal in first vote.
newsitem.headline: Portugal copper workers reject deal in first vote.

text.p: A deal offered by Portugal's Somincor company to ensure Sunday working at the Neves Corvo copper mine was rejected by a first batch of workers to vote on Thursday, union officials said.
The same deal will be put to the evening shift later on Thursday, they added.
The officials said that the first vote had included workers from the morning and afternoon shifts. The final vote would be for the third, overnight shift.
"The proposal was rejected," union leader Eduardo Lazaro told Reuters by telephone from the mine.
Lazaro said that he had no doubts that the overnight shift would also reject the offer by Somincor which would have given miners more holidays in return for working on Sundays.
He said that workers continued to regard the number of Sundays to be worked under the company scheme as "exaggerated".
